slides.subtitle: What engineers must know about Anthropic's latest production release.
slides.body: A major architectural upgrade announced for Anthropic.
slides.deep_dive: Anthropic has introduced new architectural improvements that enhance accuracy, latency, and context efficiency.
slides.key_fact: Delivers marked improvements in reasoning accuracy and token throughput.
slides.why_it_matters: Enables engineers to build more capable autonomous agents with lower operational overhead.

slides.title: Core Architectural Upgrades
slides.body: How Anthropic fundamentally shifts the capabilities of frontier AI systems:
before_items: Narrower context windows requiring complex chunking RAG pipelines
Higher per-token pricing constraining high-throughput batch workloads
Elevated latency on multi-step reasoning and autonomous tool calls
after_items: Massive context capacity handling full codebases & multimodal assets
Up to 50% lower operational inference costs for production workloads
Optimized KV cache kernels delivering sub-second time-to-first-token

slides.title: Developer Workflow Shift
slides.body: Comparing previous engineering workarounds with modern capabilities:
before_items: Brittle regex-based post-processing of model completions
Manual fallbacks for context window overflow errors
Multi-model chaining required for vision, code, and text
after_items: Native constrained decoding adhering strictly to JSON schemas
Single prompt ingestion of comprehensive repository architectures
Unified multimodal understanding in a single forward pass

slides.title: Production Deployment Case
slides.body: How engineering teams deploy Anthropic at high scale:
slides.scenario: Running multi-agent code refactoring across enterprise repositories requires guaranteed schema adherence and rapid feedback loops.
slides.technical_detail: Leveraging Anthropic's low-latency streaming and high-capacity context simplifies pipeline orchestration.
slides.result: 40% reduction in agent cycle duration and zero schema validation failures.

slides.title: Engineering Migration Checklist
slides.body: Practical steps software engineers should take to evaluate this release:
items: Test Anthropic on your internal evaluation harness against production baseline prompts.
Audit token costs and adjust rate limiter concurrency settings.
Adopt structured JSON schema mode for all programmatic function calls.
Implement streaming responses to optimize perceived user latency.

slides.title: Summary & Next Steps
slides.body: Actionable takeaways for software engineers and architects:
takeaways: Evaluate Anthropic's latest capabilities against existing models in your stack.
Take advantage of larger context windows to simplify multi-step RAG pipelines.
Track production latency and token spend to capture cost savings.
